mapper.insert: INSERT INTO question (question_bank_id, question_type, difficulty, content, image_url, analysis) VALUES (#{questionBankId}, #{questionType}, #{difficulty}, #{content}, #{imageUrl}, #{analysis})
mapper.update: UPDATE question SET question_bank_id = #{questionBankId}, question_type = #{questionType}, difficulty = #{difficulty}, content = #{content}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, analysis = #{analysis} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT q.id, q.question_bank_id, q.question_type, q.difficulty, q.content, q.image_url, q.created_at, q.updated_at FROM question q
ORDER BY q.updated_at DESC, q.id DESC LIMIT #{q.offset}, #{q.pageSize}
